title: gorjana x HotWax weekly
summary:
The meeting focused on Shopify’s native Opus transition, particularly store-rejected pickup orders converted to ship-to-me fulfillment. HotWax demonstrated a generic API-based flow covering warehouse brokering, NetSuite fulfillment, OMS synchronization, cancellations, and pickup-location changes. The immediate implementation requires mapping ship-to-me into the OMS as free expedited shipping through the existing warehouse flow. The customer status page, Shopify flow, AfterShip communications, and production configuration were described as ready, while mixed-card support was not expected for the Monday launch.

The proposed Shopify work was estimated at approximately 24 hours at $150 per hour, but Alex Lambert questioned the estimate because the remaining requirement appeared limited to ship-to-me mapping. The team agreed the SOW should be reviewed for a narrower scope. Shopify pickup communications are disabled in production and AfterShip is intended to manage customer communications, although HotWax is still investigating an apparent notification event. Shopify, rather than HotWax, appeared to trigger a pickup fulfillment email in one demonstrated scenario.

The team reviewed older invoices and confirmed that missing inventory reductions for exchange orders from August 10 through August 25 were corrected. Store inventory adjustments accounted for cycle counts to prevent duplicate deductions. NetSuite discount items for exchange price differences, along with tax differences when exchanges occur at different locations, remained subject to mapping and sandbox validation.

Additional discussion covered exchanges and returns producing multiple outcomes within a single HG claim. Splitting transactions while retaining the HotWax sales-return identifier may require integration changes. The team also reviewed store-credit exchanges, payment or customer-deposit balancing transactions, warranties, variances, and August transaction volumes, but no prioritization or final resolution was recorded.
